identity.title: Wishing Star of the Seven Nights: Jirachi Music Collection

leadText: Wishing Star of the Seven Nights: Jirachi Music Collection is the original Japanese soundtrack CD of the 6th Pokémon movie, Jirachi: Wish Maker. It was released in Japan on July 25, 2003.
